text: The subscriber receives a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1000 after the age of 60.
Eligible rural youth receive free skill training with a guaranteed placement; there is no direct cash benefit.
Registered workers receive an eShram card that gives access to social security and welfare schemes; there is no direct cash benefit.
Eligible children and mothers receive supplementary nutrition and pre-school services free of cost at the Anganwadi centre; there is no cash benefit.
Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of Rs. 300 per month.
Persons aged 80 years and above receive a pension of Rs. 500 per month.
Persons aged 60 to 79 years receive a pension of Rs. 200 per month.
Widows aged 80 years and above receive a pension of Rs. 500 per month.
Widows aged 40 to 79 years receive a pension of Rs. 300 per month.
Every eligible rural household receives an in-kind functional household tap water connection; there is no cash benefit.
An eligible farmer is sanctioned a credit limit of up to Rs. 3 lakh at a concessional interest rate.
Each eligible child receives a free hot cooked meal on every school day; there is no cash benefit.
Each rural household is guaranteed up to 100 days of wage employment per financial year, paid at the notified daily wage rate.
Loan limits are tiered: Shishu up to Rs. 50000, Kishore up to Rs. 5 lakh and Tarun up to Rs. 10 lakh, based on the applicant's annual income.
Members organised into self-help groups receive a revolving fund of about Rs. 15000 per group along with bank credit and interest subvention.
Hostellers receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 3,500 per year in addition to fee reimbursement.
Day scholars receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 7,000 per year including ad-hoc grant.
Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households receive 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month.
Priority Household (PHH) families receive 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month.
In plain areas, assistance is Rs. 1,20,000 per unit for house construction.
An eligible beneficiary receives central assistance of about Rs. 2.67 lakh towards the house.
An eligible beneficiary can set up a project with a maximum project cost of Rs. 10 lakh in the service sector.
An enrolled farmer receives a sum insured of up to Rs. 1 lakh against crop loss.
An eligible micro enterprise receives a credit-linked subsidy of 35 percent of the project cost, up to a maximum of Rs. 10 lakh.
Eligible families receive an annual health cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family (shared across members) for hospitalisation.
Account holders receive an accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh on the RuPay debit card.
The nominee receives a life cover of Rs. 2 lakh on the death of the insured due to any reason.
Eligible farmer families receive Rs. 2,000 per instalment, three instalments per year (total Rs. 6,000 per year).
The subscriber receives an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3000 after attaining the age of 60.
An eligible farmer receives a subsidy of up to Rs. 60000 towards the cost of a solar pump.
An eligible mother receives a cash benefit of Rs. 5000 for the first living child.
Hostellers receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 1,200 per month (Rs. 13,500 per year including book grant).
Day scholars receive a maintenance allowance of Rs. 700 per month (Rs. 7,500 per year including book grant).
Accidental death or total disability is covered up to Rs. 2 lakh.
An eligible woman receives a free LPG connection worth about Rs. 1600, including the security deposit, first refill and a stove.
An eligible artisan receives a toolkit incentive of Rs. 15000 along with skill training.
An eligible household receives an incentive of Rs. 12000 for constructing a toilet.
A minimum deposit of Rs. 250 per year earns the notified rate of interest and the maturity proceeds are fully tax-free.
An eligible entrepreneur can avail a composite loan of between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore.
An eligible street vendor receives a first working capital loan of Rs. 10000.
